fields.title: Rank Ordering
fields.description: A list of ordering criteria to assign ranks.

fields.title: Category columns
fields.description: Defines how ranking should be grouped. If one or more columns are selected, ranking is computed separately within each unique group defined by the selected columns. If no category columns are specified, ranking is applied to the entire dataset.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: If there are ties
fields.description: Defines how tied values are handled in the ranking:

fields.title: Rank column name
fields.description: Defines the name of the appended ranking column. This field cannot be left empty.

fields.title: Rank data type
fields.description: Specifies the data type for the ranking column

fields.title: Sort missing values to end of table
fields.description: If selected, missing values are always placed at the end of the ranked output, regardless of the ranking order. This means that in ascending order, missing values are considered larger than any non-missing value, while in descending order, they are considered smaller than any non-missing value. If left unchecked (default), missing values follow the defined ranking behavior and are treated as the smallest possible value.

fields.title: Row order
fields.description: Defines how the output table is ordered after ranking:
